title: Dividing two polynomials by their gcd leaves coprime quotients
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $a,b\in K[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] with $b\neq0$. Then there are $g,A_1,B_1\in K[T]$ with $g\neq0$, $a=gA_1$, $b=gB_1$, and $A_1,B_1$ coprime [def-weil-coprime-polynomials]; one may take $g=\gcd(a,b)$, $A_1=a/g$, $B_1=b/g$.

source.place: ## Proof, fourth paragraph ("the greatest common divisor of $A_0,B_0$ over $\mathbf Q[T]$ ... the two quotients are coprime")
